name: mergecat
description: Changesets of a Git branch for AI assistants (GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, GitLab Duo, Claude Code): tags, and changelogs of any range (tags, dates or commits) as documents of the conversation, in English and Markdown by default or in another language and as PDF on request; asks the EU AI Act / NIS2 compliance question once per session and keeps an audit record.
